comment: Exercise 15.1: MiniDAQ's hazard chains, rated before risk control. A colleague's first three; write ten.

chains.hazard: Packets lost on the readout link
chains.sequence: The link drops packets at a high count rate; the run ends normally.
chains.hazardous_situation: Images are reconstructed from incomplete data.

chains.sequence: The time code wraps and the unwrapping fails.
Power fails while a file is written.
chains.hazardous_situation: The damaged file is reconstructed as if it were intact.
chains.harm: Artifacts contribute to an incorrect diagnosis.
